newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - DEL MONTE H1 SHR DROPS, NO DIV.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - DEL MONTE H1 SHR DROPS, NO DIV.

text.p: Full name: Del Monte Royal Foods Ltd
NOTE - In view of the need to retain cash within the group,
the company said it was not paying a dividend and did not expect
to pay a final dividend. Del Monte will transfer 1.6 billion
rand from its share premium account to cover restructuring costs
of 360 million rand, a 1.2 billion rand write down of trademarks
and the write off of 50 million in premium on the acquisition of
Analysts had expected a fall in earnings but most declined
to predict figures after the firm recently issued a profit
